meta.description: DumpGuard NJ recheck: alternating-week anchors, holidays, ZIP sharing, drop-off, source dates.

alternating_recycling_anchors.notes: Stone Ct, Aimy Ct, Rachele Ct; Monday pickup though mapped Ward 3.
Arbors, Sonoma Court, Lakeridge West; Tuesday though mapped Ward 4.
Jan 1 2026 Thursday moved to Saturday Jan 3 per borough 2026 page.
Jan 5 is Monday; zone 6 list uses holiday-shifted dates.
Jan 19 pickup moved to Wed Jan 21 (MLK).
Jan 1 D1 moved to Wed Dec 31 2025 per calendar.
Contract effective May 11 2026; first White Week after May 11.
Contract effective May 11 2026; first White Week after May 11.

old-bridge.holiday_rule: If a Holiday falls on your recycling day, pickup that Saturday.

piscataway.holiday_rule: If collection day falls on a holiday, collection rescheduled for the following Saturday.

sayreville.holiday_rule: Municipal Public Works holidays do NOT affect MCIA recycling collection.

south-amboy.holiday_rule: 2026 dates listed on borough PDF; MCIA hotline for weather changes.

south-plainfield.holiday_rule: No collection Thanksgiving or Christmas; makeup dates on calendar table.

fair-haven.holiday_rule: Borough office/DPW holiday closures listed on 2026 municipal calendar; check website for collection shifts.

hazlet.holiday_rule: Recycling yard closed on listed holidays; zone recycling dates shifted per Green Booklet (e.g. Nov 3 zone 2 to Nov 2).

keyport.holiday_rule: No garbage/recycling pickup New Year's Day, Christmas Day, or Thanksgiving Day; following day when weather permits.

little-silver.holiday_rule: No trash or recycling curbside collection on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, or New Year's Day.

neptune-city.holiday_rule: No recycling or garbage collection Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's, or July 4.

neptune-township.holiday_rule: Neptune Township: garbage/recycling on holiday moved to Wednesday same week. Ocean Grove: garbage canceled that day; if holiday is Wednesday OG recycling moves to Friday.

matawan.holiday_rule: If pickup missed due to holiday or severe weather, remaining pickups that week move one day later.

carteret.holiday_rule: See 2026 Sanitation Calendar for holiday week shifts.

highland-park.holiday_rule: Collection date subject to change in the event of a holiday.

metuchen.holiday_rule: Holiday-week shifts on 2026 DPW calendar PDFs.

perth-amboy.holiday_rule: If holiday falls on regularly scheduled garbage day, service resumes next scheduled collection day.

aberdeen.holiday_rule: If recycling or garbage day falls on New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, or Christmas Day, pick-up on the next scheduled pick-up day.

allenhurst.holiday_rule: No explicit holiday override text on Public Works page (undated).

atlantic-highlands.holiday_rule: See borough 2026 sanitation calendar PDF on Public Works page for holiday trash delays.

bradley-beach.holiday_rule: 2026 sanitation calendar PDF on site; holiday trash delays on Public Works page.

highlands.holiday_rule: No trash pickup Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day (2026 calendar).

interlaken.holiday_rule: On holidays, pick up will be the next day.

keansburg.holiday_rule: No curbside collection Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year's Day.

loch-arbour.holiday_rule: Bulk schedule only on village site; trash/recycling weekdays via Deal (not restated on Loch Arbour page).

middletown.holiday_rule: No garbage on New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; next scheduled garbage day. Recycling on those holidays collected following Saturday if scheduled.

monmouth-beach.holiday_rule: No pickup Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year's Day; next regularly scheduled day.

oceanport.holiday_rule: See borough site; 2026 holiday garbage/recycling schedule referenced on Public Works page.

red-bank.holiday_rule: Public Utilities page (undated); no 2026 override table on fetched page.

rumson.holiday_rule: See Rumson Public Works / 2026 calendar references on borough site.

sea-bright.holiday_rule: No pickup Thanksgiving Day on weekly schedules listed on Public Works page.

west-long-branch.holiday_rule: No collection New Year's Day, Independence Day, Election Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas. Recycling: no pickup Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year's Day (next regular day).

07711.source_note: Both municipalities list 07711 on official contact/Public Works pages.

07735.source_note: Aberdeen and Keyport zips in towns_research; Union Beach Contact Us lists 07735.

07734.source_note: Hazlet 07734 mobile-home page; Keansburg contact lists 07734.

07732.source_note: Keyport DPW address Keyport NJ 07732; Highlands DPW lists 07732.

07747.source_note: Both municipalities publish 07747 on official recycling/ trash pages.

07753.source_note: Both use 07753 on official public works pages.

07760.source_note: Rumson and Sea Bright official sites list 07760.

07701.source_note: Red Bank FAQ: 07701 is mail delivery only; many addresses are in Middletown, Shrewsbury, or Fair Haven.

dropoff.name: Carteret Recycling Center / DPW Building
dropoff.hours: 7am-3pm Mon-Fri; 7am-11am Sat

dropoff.name: DPW electronics / cardboard drop-off
dropoff.hours: Cardboard Mon-Fri 7:00am-2:30pm; DPW Mon-Fri 6:30am-3:00pm

dropoff.name: Public Works yard cardboard drop-off (scheduled Saturdays)
dropoff.hours: Cardboard only Sat Dec 26 2026 and Sat Jan 2 2027, 8:00am-12:00pm

dropoff.name: Recycling Drop-Off Center (Township Municipal Complex, behind Animal Shelter)
dropoff.hours: Tuesday and Thursday 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
dropoff.accepts_text: Extra cardboard can be brought to the Recycling Center (2026 curbside recycling PDF).

dropoff.name: Piscataway Mini-Dump (Recycling & Trash Center)
dropoff.hours: Tuesday and Thursday 2:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. (gates close 7:45 p.m.); Saturday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (gates close 4:15 p.m.); closed Sun–Mon and Wed–Fri; closed on holidays falling on Tue or Thu
dropoff.accepts_text: The following items may NOT be brought to the Mini-Dump: Contractor debris; Dirt; Hazardous waste; Kitchen garbage; Paint; Rocks; Stones.

dropoff.name: Fort Grumpy Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday and Friday 7:30 a.m.–1:00 p.m. (gates close 12:55); 1st and 3rd Saturday 7:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (gates close 11:55)

dropoff.name: Mary B. Mazepa South Plainfield Recycling Drop-off Center
dropoff.hours: Tuesday 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; Thursday, Friday, Saturday 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (gates close 10 minutes early; closed borough holidays)
dropoff.accepts_text: Drop-off: newspaper, mixed paper, cardboard (flattened), glass bottles, aluminum/steel/tin cans, plastic bottles/jugs/jars/tubs (separated by material at site). Residents only extras: clothes, used motor oil (up to 5 gal), cooking oil, rechargeable batteries, cell phones, paint (3rd Sat/month), appliances, computers, monitors, printers, TVs, scrap metal.

dropoff.name: South Plainfield Yard Waste Site
dropoff.hours: Jan 1–Mar 31: Saturday 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Apr 1–Dec 31: Mon–Sat hours vary (see Curbside page); closed borough holidays; decal required
dropoff.accepts_text: Drop-off: newspaper, mixed paper, cardboard (flattened), glass bottles, aluminum/steel/tin cans, plastic bottles/jugs/jars/tubs (separated by material at site). Residents only extras: clothes, used motor oil (up to 5 gal), cooking oil, rechargeable batteries, cell phones, paint (3rd Sat/month), appliances, computers, monitors, printers, TVs, scrap metal.

dropoff.name: Aberdeen Public Works Garage drop-off
dropoff.hours: Monday through Saturday, 7 am to 3 pm

dropoff.name: Borough Yard recycling facility
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Saturday until 11:00 a.m. (recycling only). 2026 calendar also lists Mon–Fri 6:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. and Sat 6:00 a.m.–11:00 a.m. for recycling; Nov–Dec Sat–Sun 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. for leaves and brush.

dropoff.name: Trash/Recycling Lot
dropoff.hours: Monday, Thursday–Sunday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; closed when borough closed on holidays

dropoff.name: Public Works Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; closed Sunday
dropoff.accepts_text: Recycling (i.e. cardboard, bottles, cans). Electronics and Clothing items. This area is NOT for TRASH!

dropoff.name: Hazlet Township DPW Recycling Yard
dropoff.hours: Regular: Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Sat 8:15 a.m.–1:45 p.m., Sun closed; Memorial Day–Labor Day weekdays 7:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; closed municipal holidays
dropoff.accepts_text: See Green Booklet 2026 and HazletTwp.org/Recycling for acceptable curbside and yard materials; grass clippings not accepted at recycling yard.

dropoff.name: Highlands Borough Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Sat 7:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m., Sun closed

dropoff.name: Borough Yard
dropoff.hours: Winter: Monday–Saturday 7:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Summer: Monday–Saturday 7:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; closed Sunday and holidays

dropoff.name: Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; closed Sunday and holidays

dropoff.name: Keyport Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Saturdays 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon (except holidays); drop-off of recyclables and pick-up of leaf bags
dropoff.accepts_text: Saturdays 9:00 a.m.-12:00 noon drop-off of recyclables and pick-up of leaf bags (Keyport recycling page / 2026 schedule PDF).

dropoff.name: Borough Recycling Center / Public Works Yard
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 noon; closed Borough holidays

dropoff.name: Matawan Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday through Friday 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; Saturday and Sunday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.

dropoff.name: Middletown Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Thursday through Monday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; closed Tuesday, Wednesday, and major holidays (New Year's Day, Easter Sunday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day)

dropoff.name: Middletown Train Station satellite recycling center
Neptune City Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Tuesday 7 a.m.–5 p.m.; Wednesday–Friday 7 a.m.–2 p.m.; Saturday 7 a.m.–12 noon (except holidays)

dropoff.name: Neptune Township Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.

dropoff.name: Borough of Red Bank Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Tuesday–Friday 7:05 AM–2:55 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM–2:00 PM; closed Sunday and Monday

dropoff.name: Rumson Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM; Sunday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed borough holidays

dropoff.name: Long Branch Recycling Center (Sea Bright shared services — electronics only)
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.

dropoff.name: Union Beach Department of Public Works and Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; 1st and 3rd Saturday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; closed Sundays and holidays
dropoff.proof_required: Identification if asked; sign in at office

dropoff.name: West Long Branch DPW Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m.; Sunday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
